PluginData.Author: Sirius_L
PluginData.Tooltip: Fixed the issue of monospace font display abnormalities in Chinese. 修复了中文游戏下monospace字体显示异常的问题。
PluginData.Description: This mod fixes the issue of monospace font display abnormalities in Chinese and is compatible with the built-in Text Surface Scripts text display, without causing the TSS text to turn into blocks. 此mod修复了中文下monospace字体显示异常的问题,并且兼容原版LCD内置脚本的文字显示,不会导致内置脚本文字变成方块。
